::: {#exr-negate-conditional}
#### A broken deployment rule

A team's rule is "if the tests pass, then the build is deployed".
Let $P$ be "the tests pass" and $Q$ be "the build is deployed".
The rule is broken on the days when $\neg (P \Rightarrow Q)$ is true.

Write $\neg (P \Rightarrow Q)$ without $\Rightarrow$, and in English.

:::
